title: The Chosen Successor
logline: A religious sect's leader has died, and their ambitious heir hires a pilot to falsify the signs of succession.

roles.description: Entitled, polished, completely lacking in spiritual depth.
Cynical, digging for the truth but terrified of the sect's power.
A powerful, wealthy order that controls vast local real estate.
A gilded, absurdly fragile vessel used for rituals.

public_situation: The venerable leader of the {role:sect_leadership} has passed away, and the system awaits the traditional 'Sign of the Stars' to name their successor.
private_truth: The 'Sign' is a complete fabrication, but the heir's equipment broke down and they desperately need an outsider to trigger the pyrotechnics.

beats.public_change: The ceremonial barge takes up position in orbit for the succession ritual.

missions.reason: The heir hires the pilot to quietly buy and deliver military-grade flares to the barge.
missions.private_fact: The heir plans to use the flares to fake a celestial alignment.

beats.public_change: The journalist publishes a hit piece suggesting the heir is manipulating the succession.

missions.reason: The journalist pays the pilot to scan the barge for rigged pyrotechnics.
missions.private_fact: The scan clearly shows the freshly delivered flares.

beats.public_change: The succession ceremony begins, broadcast live across the sector.

missions.reason: The heir hires the pilot to formally certify the 'Sign' as authentic via ship sensors.
missions.private_fact: The heir is paying an exorbitant sum for a false certification.

player_choice.prompt: The pilot has proof the ritual is faked. They can hand it to the journalist, or extort the heir.

options.label: Give the proof to the journalist
Blackmail the heir for a payout

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot gives the proof to the journalist.
resolutions.summary: The ritual is exposed as a farce. The heir is cast out, and the sect descends into a bitter schism.

consequences.public_summary: Someone proved the big holy succession was just cheap fireworks.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot covers up the scan or extorts the heir.
resolutions.summary: The 'Sign' appears on schedule. The heir takes power and immediately begins looting the sect's treasury.
Without the flares, the ritual fails. The sect takes it as a dark omen and retreats into isolation.

loose_threads.detail: The ceremonial barge was secretly purchased months before the old leader even fell ill.
The journalist lets slip that their 'source' is an anonymous encrypted comm ping that perfectly predicted the leader's death.

radio_hooks: {role:sect_leadership} announces succession ceremony will proceed as ordained.

voice_direction.ambitious_heir: Smug, aristocratic, uses spiritual buzzwords completely incorrectly.
voice_direction.doubting_journalist: Fast-talking, paranoid, sounds like they haven't slept in a week.
